def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    purchase_price = 50.00
    shares = 100
    commission_per_share = 0.05
    leverage_ratio = 2.0
    call_money_rate = 0.06
    ending_price = 70.00
    dividend_per_share = 0.50

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    stock_cost = purchase_price * shares
    commission = commission_per_share * shares
    initial_equity = stock_cost / leverage_ratio + commission
    borrowed_amount = stock_cost - stock_cost / leverage_ratio
    interest = borrowed_amount * call_money_rate
    ending_value = ending_price * shares
    dividends = dividend_per_share * shares
    net_profit = ending_value + dividends - stock_cost - commission - interest
    total_return = net_profit / initial_equity * 100

    # return answer
    return round(total_return, 2)
